research_topics.mythology_and_lore: The volcanic ash-wastes of Kael-Drakor. Ruled by dragon-riding warlords who bond with massive basalt drakes. The Sun was extinguished two centuries ago by the Shadow Veil, leaving only geothermal vents and glowing magma lakes to sustain life.
research_topics.magic_system_rules: 1. Drake-Bond: Neural link between rider and drake. Death of one blinds the other. 2. Sun-Singing: High priestesses channel dormant solar heat to purify volcanic ash into arable soil.
research_topics.character_psychology: Seraphina (Protagonist): Last Sun-Singer of the Western Canyons. Defiant, unyielding, refuses to bow to dragon-lords. General Rhaegar (Male Lead): Supreme commander of the Drake Legion. Brutal, solitary, burdened with preventing the volcanic collapse of the continent.
research_topics.trope_pacing: Warlord and captive priestess. Mating bond discovery. War council clashes. Epic aerial battles. Breathless forced proximity in desert tents.
